titre: Devoir de contrôle n°2 - Anglais (1ère année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Climate change is one of the most serious problems facing our planet today. Because of pollution and the burning of fossil fuels, the temperature of the Earth is rising. As a result, ice is melting at the poles, sea levels are rising, and many regions suffer from droughts or floods. Scientists warn that if we do not act now, the situation will get worse. But there is still hope. Governments can invest in clean energy like solar and wind power. Individuals can also help by saving energy, using public transport and planting trees. Protecting our planet is not only the job of governments; it is the responsibility of every human being.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What is one of the most serious problems facing our planet?   (2 marks)
2) What are the causes of climate change according to the text?   (2 marks)
3) Give two consequences of the rising temperature.   (2 marks)
4) Give two solutions that individuals can adopt.   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete the first conditional: If we do not act now, the situation ______ (get) worse.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with "should / must" (advice): Individuals ______ save energy.   (1,5 marks)
3) Put into the passive: "Pollution causes climate change."   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "clean" (energy) = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"How can we protect our planet from climate change?" Write a paragraph (about 8-10 lines) giving at least two solutions and explaining their importance. Use "should / must" and linkers.
